'''Jori Congar''' was a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Appearance ==
He was skinny, light fingered, and a good shot with the bow.

== Activities ==
He was part of the Two Rivers men in [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army in [[Ghealdan]].

When Perrin met with the [[Seanchan]], he got Jori to shoot an arrow into a branch he held up, to show that Two Rivers men were hiding in the bushes and would fire on the Seanchan if necessary.

He took part in the battle against the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] in the town of [[Malden]].

Jori was present when Perrin created ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' and then declared to his followers his acceptance at becoming their Lord and leader. Jori took part in the battle against the [[Shadowspawn]] that were about to ambush the [[Whitecloak]]s. Jori warned Perrin that the Whitecloak army was under extreme duress and Perrin decided to ride in with his force to fight beside them.
He [[Traveling|Traveled]] with Perrin and the rest of his huge force to the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].

He bled to death buried under body of a [[Trolloc]] in the Last Battle at the Field of Merrilor. [[Rand al'Thor]] saw his death during his struggle against the Dark One.
